sentences.text: Adult Jingshanosaurus reached a length of 5 meters and weighed approximately 4.3 tons.
Some sources estimate Jingshanosaurus reached a length of about 10 meters and a height of 2.5 meters.
Fossils of Jingshanosaurus were discovered near the town of Jingshan in Yunnan Province, China, giving the animal its name.
The genus was first formally described in 1995 by Zhang and Yang.
A nearly complete skeleton including the skull has been found, and Jingshanosaurus is considered the last prosauropod to live on Earth.
Researchers believe Jingshanosaurus may have had an omnivorous diet.
Jingshanosaurus is classified within the suborder Prosauropoda.
Jingshanosaurus belongs to the family Massospondylidae.
In 2004, paleontologists Peter Galton and Paul Upchurch grouped Jingshanosaurus into the clade Plateosauria.
Jingshanosaurus lived in China during the Early Jurassic period, specifically between 201.4 and 196.5 million years ago.
The fossil record for Jingshanosaurus spans from 201.4 to 199.5 million years ago.
It is debated whether Jingshanosaurus is a distinct genus or merely a large specimen of Yunnanosaurus, which would make it a junior synonym.
